---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  mutate(
    player = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      first_year <= 2009 & last_year >= 1994,
      "Overlapped 1994-2009",
      "No overlap"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs),
    fill = steroid_era
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Steroid-era overlap",
    values = c("No overlap" = "gray65", "Overlapped 1994-2009" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Runs: The All-Time Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database. Overlap means a career intersected 1994-2009."
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds's Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
